descriptions.zh:
- 包年包月实例不支持手动释放，实例到期后会自动释放。
- 只有运行状态为**运行中**的按量付费实例支持通过本接口释放。
descriptions.en:
*   Subscription instances cannot be manually released. They are automatically released when they expire.
*   You can call this operation to release pay-as-you-go instances only when they are in the **Running** state.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb delete-ai-node --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --ai-node-pool-id aipool-xxxx --ai-node-num 1 --node-names ai-xxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
